title: How to Obtain Caste & Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC/Cat-1)
issuingAuthority: Tahsildar / Revenue Department / Nadakacheri / Seva Sindhu
requiredDocuments: Applicant Aadhaar Card and School Transfer Certificate (TC) showing caste
Father / Mother Caste Certificate or School Certificate showing community
Ration Card or Voter ID proving residence in Karnataka

steps.title: Apply Online via Seva Sindhu / Nadakacheri
steps.description: Visit sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in or Nadakacheri portal and select Caste Certificate (Form D for SC/ST, Form E/F for Category 1/2A/2B/3A/3B).

steps.title: Revenue Inspector Inspection
steps.description: Village Accountant / Revenue Inspector verifies caste records with local genealogical records.

steps.title: Digital Certificate Issuance
steps.description: Tahsildar signs and generates digital RD certificate with barcode and RD number.

validityPeriod: Life-time for SC/ST; 5 Years for OBC Category in Karnataka unless notified otherwise.
